methodology.thresholdTransformation: Divide frozen pre-split thresholds by 4; only raw post-split prices are evaluated.
methodology.dividendTreatment: Credit distribution entitlement once from raw-price holdings at the prior close; track unpaid amounts as receivables until pay date; do not use dividend-adjusted prices or reinvest distributions.
methodology.calendarWindowsInterpretation: Descriptive, pre-fixed calendar segments. Parameters are unchanged across segments; this is not a preregistered prospective holdout.
